clash_controls.py <repo> <base-rev> <outdir>

Controls of clash_scan.py (fill bb1-machine), and the pre-scan of the planned glue names. Run as
`python3 -I clash_controls.py /home/user/fill/wt-sub 7c0a55e0 <outdir>`. Loads clash_scan.py
from its own directory (by path; `-I` puts no script directory on sys.path), builds the base index
at <base-rev> from git objects, and runs the scanner's core (`added_decls` + `classify`) on
synthetic head files:
  K1 a synthetic NEW file under namespaces mixing fake and existing names, each with an expected
     status (CLASH for an existing public name; for an existing private name; for a dotted name
     `IBEScheme.sidSpec_eq` inside the outer namespace; for a `_root_.`-qualified existing name;
     inside `section`/`noncomputable section`/`mutual` blocks; after a partial `end`; OK for
     fresh names; anonymous instances and names in comments/strings ignored).
  K2 a synthetic ADDED LINE in the base Defs.lean (a duplicate `oracleImpl_one` inserted after
     line 387, inside `namespace IBEScheme`): CLASH (same file, one more declaration than base).
  K3 a synthetic CHANGED header line of an existing declaration (`oracleImpl_two` in Defs.lean,
     binder renamed): MODIFIED (not a new name).
  PRE the planned glue of `BonehBoyenMachine/Oracles.lean` (namespace
     TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.IdentityBased, then BB1Machine): the six private
     `cast_eq_padFin`, `ofFn_padFin_ofFn`, `ofFn_decAnswer_some`, `sidSpec_rng_one'`,
     `sidSpec_rng_two'`, `expect_bb1SimImpl` and the public
     `abs_expect_bb1Sim_sub_distinguisherL_le`; written to <outdir>/planned-prescan.tsv.
Prints one line per control and `ALL_CONTROLS_OK True|False`, then the pre-scan's RESULT.

(bb1-sim-statements, lead: copied unchanged from the bb1-machine delivery, evidence/clash/.)
clash_scan.py <repo> <base-rev> <head-rev> <out-dir-or-tsv>

Name-clash scan of fill bb1-machine (brief: "Checks and report" -> "Name-clash scan"). Run as
`python3 -I clash_scan.py ...`. Reads git objects only (`git diff`, `git ls-tree -r`,
`git cat-file --batch`), never the working tree; runs no Lean.

1. New declarations: every declaration whose header line is added between <base-rev> and
   <head-rev> in a `TCSlib/**/*.lean` file (new files: every line; changed files: the `+` lines of
   `git diff -U0`). Kinds: theorem, lemma, def, abbrev, instance (named only), structure,
   inductive, class (incl. `class inductive`), opaque, axiom, alias, irreducible_def; with the
   modifiers private / protected / noncomputable / partial / unsafe / nonrec / scoped / local
   recorded as flags. Only lines outside comments and strings count, whose first token is the
   command (indentation allowed: one base file indents a `lemma`).
2. Full names are resolved from the enclosing `namespace X.Y` / `section [S]` / `mutual` /
   `end [..]` blocks (a dotted namespace contributes all its components; `end X.Y` closes it),
   and a dotted declaration name `Foo.bar` inside namespace `N` resolves to `N.Foo.bar`;
   `_root_.` is honoured.
3. Base index: every `.lean` file of `TCSlib/` and `audits/` at <base-rev> is parsed the same way.
   A new name is CLASH if a declaration with the same resolved full name exists at <base-rev> in
   another file, or in the same file when the head file holds more declarations of that name than
   the base file (otherwise a declaration whose full name already exists in the same file at
   <base-rev> is classified MODIFIED: a changed header line of an existing declaration, not a new
   name). Two new declarations with the same full name
   are DUP-NEW. Same-short-name (last component) declarations elsewhere are listed as INFO.
Private names are compared like public ones (the brief: "public or private, namespaces resolved").
Not covered (stated, not checked): auto-generated names (structure fields/`mk`, inductive
constructors, `simps`/`to_additive`/equation lemmas), declarations produced by macros.

Output: <out>/clash.tsv (or <out> itself when it ends in .tsv) with columns
status, full_name, kind, flags, head_location, clash_locations, info_same_short_name; and a
summary printed and appended as `RESULT: <n> new names, <k> clashes` (exit 0 iff k == 0 and no
DUP-NEW).

The core is importable: `parse_decls(text)` -> declarations, `base_index(repo, rev)` -> index,
`added_decls(text, added_lines, path)` -> new declarations of a (synthetic) head file,
`classify(new_decls, index)` -> rows (used by clash_controls.py).

set (probe/READERS-TO-INSERT.md §2) with clash_scan.py's core (loaded by path from this directory).

deliver.py <delivery-dir> <base-rev> [<name>=<worktree>]... (bb1-sim-statements, lead): ADAPTED from the
bb1-machine delivery's deliver.py. Changes: several series, one per <name>=<worktree> (patches/<name>/ and
src/<name>/ from `git format-patch <base>..HEAD` of that worktree), the am-check log per series
(evidence/delivery/am-check-<name>.out), and no series at all (manifests only). Unchanged: COMMITS.tsv (hash,
author name/email/date, committer name/email/date, signing), `git am` of every patch at <base> in a scratch
clone reproducing every hash, evidence/SHA256SUMS (every file under evidence/ except itself), the top-level
SHA256SUMS (every delivered file except itself), and the path-equality check (no leading `./`).
Also: EXCLUDE (environment, comma-separated delivery-relative prefixes) leaves paths out of both manifests
(a checkpoint omits a log directory that a running process is still writing; it is not committed either).

(bb1-sim-statements, lead: copied unchanged from the bb1-machine delivery.)
sk15.py <files>: proofs of >= 15 lines (style_lint's measure: from the declaration line to the next
declaration, excluding blanks and the docstring) whose docstring lacks **Proof sketch.**

insert_blocks.py <file> <spec>... (bb1-sim-statements, lead): pure insertions. Each spec is
AFTER_LINE:BLOCK_FILE (1-based line number of the base file after which the block's lines go).
Specs are applied bottom-up so the base line numbers stay valid. The block file's text is inserted
verbatim (a trailing newline of the block file ends its last line).

runner.py <worktree> <order> <tree> <logdir> [start-module]
Checks modules in order, one Lean process at a time, through scripts/lean_check_tree.sh with
TCSLIB_OLEANS=<tree>. Per module: full log <logdir>/mods/<module with / -> _>.log and a JSON line
in <logdir>/results.jsonl (rc, error/sorry/warning counts, start/end UTC, seconds, maxrss_kb of
the checker process tree, source and object SHA-256).
G26-N1 fix (prf-mac review): errors are counted in both forms, `error:` and `error(...)`, by
^\S+\.lean:\d+:\d+: error[:(] (multiline); error_substr = raw count of the substring "error". Stops at the first failure (like ladder.sh).

decls2.py <root> <base-rev> <file>...: public declarations (full name -> (kind, line, normalized
statement)) at <base-rev> and in the working tree; prints added / removed / changed as TSV.
decls2 (gate 07 R2-03): a line starting with `|` that follows a `match … with` opened in the statement
(before the declaration's top-level `:=`) is a match arm of the statement and does not end it; only
arms of an equation-compiler definition (no `match` in the statement), the `:=`, or the next
declaration end a statement.

mkseals.py <tools-dir> <collector-log> <worktree> <rev> <outdir> <probe-subdir> <label-prefix> <module>...
Builds whole-file conservative seals with the archived Gate06/Gate10 instrumenter
(build_seals.instrument + request_payload_adapter.configure_builders: actual-Name component checks,
instance unfolding mask, EOF verification). Requests per owner = every ordinary TCSlib definition
in the owner's transitive import closure (kind def, matcher or not status-reducible), minus the exact
notation exclusion PolyExpr.eval (the conservative closure that also covers anonymous commands).
The elaborated-term rows (foreign definitions referenced by any stored constant of the owner) must be
a subset of the closure rows or of the recorded reducible/abbrev/notation exclusions.
Source bytes are taken from `git show <rev>:<path>` and must equal the worktree file when rev is HEAD.

sealsum.py <records-dir> <rundir> <touched.json> <out.tsv>: per seal probe: requests, rc, error count,
install/EOF records, and the failing declarations (error lines mapped back to source lines through the
record's source_to_probe_lines, then to declaration spans of touched.json for the source path).

touched.py <repo> <base-rev> <head-rev> <out.json> <file>...
Declaration-level text comparison (private declarations included). Each top-level declaration
command is cut from its doc comment/attributes to the next top-level command; it is keyed by its
full name (namespace-qualified; `_root_.` removed). A declaration is TOUCHED when it is new or its
text (doc comment, attributes, statement and body; trailing whitespace ignored) differs from the
base file at the same path. New files: every declaration is touched. Prints a TSV summary.

runner_full.py <worktree> <order> <tree> <logdir> (sc-garble review): runner.py's record format (results.jsonl, mods/<module>.log,
G26-N1 error count `^\S+\.lean:\d+:\d+: error[:(]`), but each probe runs `lean -DmaxErrors=0 <module>.lean` directly, with
the LEAN_PATH of probe.sh (<tree> plus the lake packages) and NO `-o`: nothing is written to <tree> (canonizer C-F02: full-file
seals are not cut at Lean's default 100 errors). One Lean process at a time; does not stop on failure.

continuation-list lexer of gates/10-efficiency/verification.zip) over each file, attaches each item
to its declaration (touched.json spans), computes the namespace/open context, and writes a native
kinds probe resolving every candidate full name of every head (and of the definition behind every
`.eq_N`/`.eq_def`/`.eq_unfold` head).

Resolution: the first existing candidate in Lean's lookup order as generated by scan1 (innermost
namespace first, private, then opened namespaces); `.eq_N`/`.eq_def`/`.eq_unfold` read their target.
